author: toketrain
body: In some older SG matches there was no deathmatch and you had to find every player and kill them. The matches would be longer (sometimes with more rewards for the length). It was very fun to set yourself up and be able to do a bunch of stuff rather than get the deathmatch right away.

replies.author: Emmaye
replies.body: That kind of sounds a little long considering SG games now can last a while (with deathmatch).

replies.author: resepignev
replies.body: +1 The deathmatch comes sometimes way to early. You don't even got a weapon or armor.
replies.body_tagged: +1 The deathmatch comes sometimes way to early. You don't even got a weapon or armor.

replies.author: toketrain
replies.body: Yeah, but they usually go pretty fast. Most people die at the middle, then everyone scatters and a couple minutes later deathmatch happens. In walls, for example, matches can last for more than an hour (I've been in a couple of those). It probably wouldn't be a big deal, and it would be kinda fun for most players. If they don't wanna do it they could do one with deathmatch.
